items.title: Henry "Sleepy" Robertson Interview, 1961-09-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever play snare drum, Thomas, or other songs?

ctx.x: She would have a… she wanted to see what it's all about. She used to try to… one time she was taking up music. She was there. We were writing a song. She was writing some songs. A fellow out there. Oh, you know how these young people there. She had several out of New York. She sung several pieces up there. She sung a contract back there for the… she went out there. It made me angry and I wouldn't prove it. Go ahead.
Did you ever play snare drum, Thomas, or other songs? Yeah. Oh, you did play snare drum?

I liked it that better than I did bass drum. Oh, you did, huh? Yeah, but they don't let me play no snare drum. Every time they want me on bass drum, they don't want somebody else on snare drum. And I'd rather play snare drum than play bass drum. I'd get the kick out of playing snare drum, but they'd rather me play bass drum.
